test_plan.volume_note: No demo submission was tracked in 90 days and the page had 8 sessions, far below about 100 submissions a month. An A/B test won't reach a clear answer; ship fixes 2 to 5 as low-risk changes and watch the trend.
hypotheses: If we make Message and Company optional, then form completion will rise, because they are the two required fields that ask for effort or repeat what the business email already tells us.
If we merge First and Last name, then completion will rise slightly, because it removes one required field without losing data.
If we add a heading and a 'what happens next' line, then form starts will rise, because visitors see what they get before they type.
test_plan.watch_quality: Track lead-to-customer rate as well as completions: dropping Company and Message can make leads harder to qualify. Enrichment from the business email covers most of it.

check_by_hand: Submit the empty form on a phone: does it jump to the first error, and does each message say how to fix it, next to the field?
Type a wrong email: is it flagged when leaving the field, not on every keystroke? Does a valid answer show it was accepted?
Type name+test@gmail.com and name@gmial.com: is the alias accepted, and is the typo caught with a suggestion?
After an error, is everything typed still there?
After a submit: is there a clear success state, and does the button show it is working while it waits?
unknowns: Funnel rates: 8 sessions and 0 form starts in 90 days, below the grading floor.
